allow_large: Owner asked (2026-10-09): a new explore kind in forge.toml for read-only work (explorer role and forge ask), on Haiku 4.5 high by default

amendments.because: Owner (2026-10-09): the read-only model is Haiku 5.5 (claude-haiku-5-5), not 4.5
amendments.done_when: forge.toml has an explore kind for read-only work, used by the explorer role on both hosts and by forge ask, separate from lite (which keeps a fix's first build round); forge init writes its Claude entry as claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 at high effort and its Codex entry as the current lite Codex entry, and this repo sets the same; a repo without an explore entry keeps using lite for these as today; sync writes the explorer role from it; the coordinator guide describes it; command tests cover a new repo, an earlier-adopted repo without the entry (unchanged behaviour), and the explorer role and forge ask picking the explore entry

done_when: forge.toml has an explore kind for read-only work, used by the explorer role on both hosts and by forge ask, separate from lite (which keeps a fix's first build round); forge init writes its Claude entry as claude-haiku-5-5 at high effort and its Codex entry as the current lite Codex entry, and this repo sets the same; a repo without an explore entry keeps using lite for these as today; sync writes the explorer role from it; the coordinator guide describes it; command tests cover a new repo, an earlier-adopted repo without the entry (unchanged behaviour), and the explorer role and forge ask picking the explore entry

findings.body: The selected diff adds only this fix record; the required implementation is absent. `src/forge/repo.py:383` excludes explore from valid kinds, `src/forge/roles.py:44` still assigns explorer to lite, and `src/forge/codex.py:155` still selects lite for forge ask. Neither `src/forge/init.py:64–98` nor forge.toml defines explore entries, so new clients and this repo do not receive claude-haiku-5-5/high or the matching lite Codex settings. `src/forge/templates/skill.md:748–777` still documents lite for ask and does not describe explore. Implement the separate kind, both hosts' explorer selection through sync, ask selection, initialization defaults, existing-client lite fallback, and coordinator documentation while preserving lite for the first fix round.
findings.title: Not done: explore kind for read-only work

findings.body: No tests are added, and the existing command tests do not prove the promised explore behavior. `tests/test_subagent_roles.py:11,18–20,93–98` tests explorer against lite, while `tests/test_models_per_family.py:84–97` tests forge ask against lite. Add command-level coverage for a new repo receiving both explore defaults, sync writing explorer from explore on both hosts, forge ask selecting explore, and an earlier-adopted repo without explore retaining lite behavior after upgrade. These are explicit Done-when cases, and the current tests would pass with the requested feature entirely absent.
findings.title: Not done: command tests for explore defaults, selection and earlier-adopted clients

why: Read-only Claude work (the explorer subagent role and quick forge ask questions) should run on Haiku 4.5 at high effort (owner, 2026-10-09), but both share forge.toml's lite setting with the first build round of every fix, so it can't change without moving fix implementation to Haiku
